js: (async()=>{window.__dPosts=[];const orig=window.fetch;window.fetch=function(...args){const url=String(args[0]&&args[0].url?args[0].url:args[0]);if(url.includes('/api/interactive')){window.__dPosts.push((args[1]&&args[1].method)||'GET')+' '+url.split('/api/interactive')[1])}return orig.apply(this,args)};const stBefore=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json();window.__dSeqBefore=stBefore.seq;const t=document.querySelector("[data-im=\"chat-toggle\"]");t.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600));const input=document.querySelector("[data-im=\"chat-input\"]");const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set;setter.call(input,'（D 独立验收）只发文字，不带板面');input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));document.querySelector("[data-im=\"chat-send\"]").click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500));const stAfter=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json();return JSON.stringify({posts:window.__dPosts,seqBefore:window.__dSeqBefore,seqAfter:stAfter.seq,chatPanel:!!document.querySelector("[data-im=\"chat-panel\"]"),scope:(document.querySelector("[data-im=\"chat-scope\"]")||{}).textContent,status:(document.querySelector("[data-im=\"chat-status\"]")||{}).textContent})})()
